tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Replicate API token and connectivity.

tools.name: replicate-list-models
tools.description: Discover models available on Replicate and their exact input parameters. Three modes: (1) collection: list models in a category. Examples: "text-to-image", "image-to-image", "image-to-text" (vision-language models / OCR / image captioning), "text-to-video", "image-to-video", "audio-generation", "text-to-speech", "speech-to-text", "language-models", "embeddings". NOTE: "video-generation" is NOT a valid collection slug — use "image-to-video" or "text-to-video" instead. (2) query: free-text search by name or description. Replicate query search is biased toward image/video generation — for vision-language models (VLM), OCR, image captioning or other non-generative tasks, prefer browsing the "image-to-text" collection directly. (3) model: get the full input/output schema for a specific model in "owner/name" format (e.g. "google/veo-3.1") — use this before replicate-run to know exactly what parameters to pass.

collection.description: Collection slug to browse. Examples: "text-to-image", "image-to-image", "image-to-text" (VLMs / OCR / image captioning), "text-to-video", "image-to-video", "audio-generation", "text-to-speech", "speech-to-text", "language-models", "embeddings". NOTE: "video-generation" is not a valid collection slug.

query.description: Free-text search query to find models by name or description. Biased toward image/video generation — for vision (VLM/OCR/captioning) prefer collection="image-to-text" instead.

model.description: Get the full schema for a specific model in "owner/name" format (e.g. "google/veo-3.1", "runwayml/gen-4.5", "kwaivgi/kling-v2.6"). Returns all input parameters with types, defaults and descriptions.

tools.name: replicate-run
tools.description: Run any model on Replicate. ALWAYS asynchronous — returns immediately with a prediction ID and status "starting". Then use replicate-get-prediction to poll until done. Use replicate-list-models first to discover the model ID and its exact input parameters. Image/video/audio inputs inside `input` must be PUBLIC URLs (https://...) or data: URIs — Replicate cannot reach internal/localhost URLs. If you pass an internal Teros objects URL (http://localhost:.../objects/obj_... or http://127.0.0.1:.../objects/obj_...), it is automatically resolved to a data URI (objects up to 10 MB). When the prediction succeeds, generated media (images, videos, audio) is persisted to internal object storage and served via permanent internal URLs — the agent never sees Replicate's temporary URLs.

model.description: Model in "owner/name" format (e.g. "google/veo-3.1", "runwayml/gen-4.5", "kwaivgi/kling-v2.6", "black-forest-labs/flux-kontext-pro"). Use replicate-list-models to find available models.

input.description: Input parameters for the model. Use replicate-list-models with the model field to get the exact schema.

tools.name: replicate-get-prediction
tools.description: Get the status and result of a prediction by ID. Poll this after replicate-run until status is "succeeded" or "failed". When succeeded, the output field contains the result served via permanent internal URLs (images, videos, audio are persisted to internal object storage — the agent never sees Replicate's temporary URLs). IMPORTANT: Replicate output URLs (including stream.replicate.com signed URLs) expire ~1h after the prediction completes. Poll promptly after replicate-run — the first poll that sees "succeeded" persists the media immediately. If the first poll happens after expiry, the download will fail and the media is unrecoverable. Repeated polls return cached internal URLs without re-downloading.

predictionId.description: The prediction ID returned by replicate-run

tools.name: replicate-cancel-prediction
tools.description: Cancel a running or queued prediction by ID.

tools.name: replicate-list-predictions
tools.description: List recent predictions with their status. Useful to track ongoing or past generations. For completed predictions, the output field contains internal permanent URLs if the media was previously persisted; otherwise output is null (Replicate's temporary URLs may have expired and cannot be retrieved).
